config.diagnostics.workspaceOnStartup.ma:
Diagnose every indexed file once the startup scan finishes, instead of only the files that get opened.

**Expensive.** This publishes a diagnostic for every problem in every indexed file, and the editor holds all of them in the problems list before a single file has been opened. On a whole mod that runs to tens of megabytes.

The scan runs after the server is ready, so nothing waits on it; the cost is editor memory and the problems list, not server responsiveness.

Leave this off unless a session starts with no diagnostics at all - a known fault where the editor's open-document notification never reaches the server, which nothing else recovers from until a restart.
config.encyclopedia.screenHeight.markdow:
Screen height, in pixels, that the encyclopedia preview draws its card for.

This is what sets the glyph size: The game derives a font height from the screen height against a 600-line reference, truncating to whole pixels, so the text does not scale smoothly - several nearby resolutions give the same size.

At exactly 800x600 the game also narrows every line's character budget by 5%, which the preview reproduces.
config.encyclopedia.screenWidth.markdown:
Screen width, in pixels, that the encyclopedia preview draws its card for.

The game sizes the popup's glyphs from the display it is running on, so the preview has to be told which display to match - set this to the resolution the mod is played at. The width converts the glyph size into the card's own units; `#aet-eaw-edit.encyclopedia.screenHeight#` sets the size itself.

Line breaks do not move with this: Those come from a character count the mod's own `encyclopedia_text` component declares.
config.features.dialog.codeActions.markd:
Enables quick fixes in story-dialog `.txt` scripts: Lightbulb actions that write a `# aetswg:suppress` comment for the diagnostic under the cursor, scoped to the line, the enclosing `[CHAPTER n]`, the file, or the whole project.

Only applies to files under the `.pgproj` `directories.storyDialog` folders.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.dialog.diagnostics.markd:
Enables the story-dialog language service: Diagnostics for dialog `.txt` scripts under the `.pgproj` `directories.storyDialog` folders (unknown commands, argument errors, missing localisation keys and speech/movie/SFX references) plus the XML-side `Story_Dialog`/`Story_Chapter` cross-checks.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.dialog.goToDefinition.ma:
Enables go-to-definition in story-dialog `.txt` scripts: `DIALOG`, `MOVIE`/`MOVIE_ONCE`, and `SFX` arguments jump to the defining XML object.

Only applies to files under the `.pgproj` `directories.storyDialog` folders.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.dialog.inlayHints.markdo:
Enables inlay hints in story-dialog `.txt` scripts: `TEXT`/`TITLE` lines show the referenced localisation text at the end of the line (or a MISSING marker for unknown keys).

Only applies to files under the `.pgproj` `directories.storyDialog` folders.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.analyzer.markdownDes:
Runs the Lua analyzer (`emmylua_ls`, bundled) behind the language server, with the open Lua scripts mirrored to it. It supplies identifier and member completion, hover for the workspace's own functions and types, references, symbols, signature help, folding, semantic highlighting, code lenses, inlay hints and its own diagnostics. `#aet-eaw-edit.lua.analyzerPath#` runs another copy.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.codeActions.markdown:
Enables code actions (quick fixes) in Lua script files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.completion.markdownD:
Enables code completion in Lua script files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.debugger.markdownDes:
Enables the Lua debugger: The *Empire at War Lua* debug type, which attaches to a running debug build of the game or launches it with the project's mod chain.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.diagnostics.markdown:
Enables diagnostics (error and warning squiggles) in Lua script files.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.goToDefinition.markd:
Enables go-to-definition in Lua script files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.hover.markdownDescri:
Enables hover tooltips in Lua script files.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.lua.rename.markdownDescr:
Enables symbol rename in Lua script files. Also required for global rename of XML objects that are referenced from Lua scripts.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.preview.energyPool.markd:
Shows the energy pool in the model preview: Its bar under the ability bar, its row in the target readout, and the `Projectile_Does_Energy_Damage` switch on the attacker.

**Off by default on purpose.** The engine implements the energy mechanic, but the shipped game disables it and offers no interface for it, so nothing authored against it reaches a player unless the mod enables it.

This setting affects the preview only. `Energy_Capacity` and `Projectile_Does_Energy_Damage` are read from the project's files either way.
config.features.story.discovery.markdown:
Enables campaign story-chain discovery: Plot manifests and story thread files are typed and validated (story event/reward parameters, chain errors like missing plot files).

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.story.graphDiagnostics.m:
Enables campaign story-graph diagnostics on story thread files: Dangling or cyclic prerequisites, duplicate and ambiguous event names, unreachable events, suspended plots nothing activates, event tag order, and over-long flag names.

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.story.discovery#` - without discovery, story files are not typed and these diagnostics never trigger.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.story.rename.markdownDes:
Enables cross-language story symbol rename: Renaming a story event, flag, or AI-notification id updates every XML and Lua occurrence in the workspace. Ambiguous event names (defined more than once) are rejected instead of mass-renamed.

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.story.symbols#` - without symbol indexing there is nothing to rename.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.story.symbols.markdownDe:
Enables cross-language story symbol indexing: Story event names, flags, and AI-notification ids become navigable symbols across XML story threads and Lua scripts (hover, go-to-definition, find references).

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.story.discovery#` - without discovery, story files are not typed and nothing is indexed.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.encyclopedia.markd:
Enables the encyclopedia popup preview: The *Preview Encyclopedia Popup* command and its code lens.

The preview reads translations but never writes any, so it is independent of `#aet-eaw-edit.features.tools.localisation#`.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.localisation.markd:
Enables the localisation tooling: The localisation editor panel's data source, the initialise/import commands, and the create-key code action.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.modBrowser.markdow:
Enables the Mod Browser: Every object, asset, script and enum the project indexes, by type, with what each names and what names it.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.modelPreview.markd:
Enables the 3D model preview: Opening an `.alo` shows the model, and a GameObject can be previewed with its hardpoints mounted.

Models that ship with the game are only reachable once `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.source.baseGameDirectory#` is set - the extension never searches for an install.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.storyEditing.markd:
Enables **Edit mode** in the story graph panel: Staging changes, previewing and validating them, and writing them back to the story XML.

Without this the panel is read-only - the graph can still be browsed in View mode.

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.tools.storyEditor#` (the panel hosting it).

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.storyEditor.markdo:
Enables the story editor protocol surface: The `aet/getStoryPlots`, `aet/getStoryGraph`, `aet/getStoryNodeDetail`, and `aet/getStorySchema` requests plus the `aet/storyGraphChanged` change notification.

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.story.discovery#` - without discovery there are no campaigns to serve.

*Work in progress - disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.storySimulator.mar:
Enables **Simulation mode** in the story graph panel: The campaign runs forward in 1 s ticks as the engine would, with every trigger the game decides answered by the author - planets captured, units built, battles won or lost, script events - from a fact table seeded by the campaign XML. The panel shows the flow along the edges, the decisions the story waits on, the world, the flags, each script's state machine, and a trace of every transition. A battle runs as its own session in its own panel while the galaxy stands still, as in the game.

The simulation reproduces the engine's event rules; it does not run the galactic layer, so nothing moves, builds or fights unless the author says it did.

Builds on `#aet-eaw-edit.features.tools.storyEditor#` (the panel hosting it).

*Disabled by default.*

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.tools.variants.markdownD:
Enables the variant-inheritance tooling: The *Show Effective Object* command and its code lens.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.autoCloseTag.markdow:
Automatically inserts the matching closing tag on typing the `>` that ends an XML opening tag.

Requires VS Code's `#editor.formatOnType#` setting to be enabled to take effect.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.codeActions.markdown:
Enables code actions (quick fixes) in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.codeLens.markdownDes:
Enables code lenses (reference counts, variant links) in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.completion.markdownD:
Enables code completion in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.diagnostics.markdown:
Enables diagnostics (error and warning squiggles) in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.findReferences.markd:
Enables find-all-references in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.formatting.markdownD:
Formats EaW XML files and selections: re-indents the whitespace between tags and comments, and changes nothing the game reads. Well-formed files only. Off, the server offers no formatter, so another XML formatter can take the files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.goToDefinition.markd:
Enables go-to-definition in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.hover.markdownDescri:
Enables hover tooltips in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.inlayHints.markdownD:
Enables inlay hints in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.linkedEditing.markdo:
Enables linked editing of matching XML tag pairs: Renaming an opening tag renames its closing tag simultaneously.

Requires VS Code's `#editor.linkedEditing#` setting to be enabled to take effect.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.rename.markdownDescr:
Enables symbol rename in EaW XML files.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.features.xml.strictness.markdownD:
Reports XML the game reads but standard XML tools reject, or that the game reads differently from what the file shows. A file the game drops is reported regardless.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.game.arguments.markdownDescriptio: Extra command-line arguments for the game when the Lua debugger launches it, placed before the mod chain.
config.game.executable.markdownDescripti:
Path to the internal/debug `StarWarsI.exe` the Lua debugger launches. A retail build has no Lua debug server.

Only used when `#aet-eaw-edit.features.lua.debugger#` is enabled.
config.game.luaDebugHost.markdownDescrip: The machine running the game. The debugger talks to it over UDP.
config.game.luaDebugPort.markdownDescrip: The game's Lua debug UDP port. The game takes the first free port from 1234 upward.
config.game.unsafeTableExpansion.markdow: Allows expanding table values in the Variables view. The game is reported to crash on a table member whose text is 255 bytes or longer, so leave this off unless losing the game session is acceptable.
config.localisation.format.markdownDescr:
Default format offered when initialising a new localisation project. Only used when the `.pgproj` does not already declare a `localisation` node - an existing project's own declared format always wins.

To change an existing project's format, run **EaWEdit: Set Localisation Project Format**, or use the button in the Localisation view's title bar.
config.localisation.format.markdownEnumD:
The game's proprietary *.DAT format.

*Not recommended if the project is being worked on by multiple people.*
A comma-separated file per language. Recommended.
An XML file used by the [Empire at War Text Editor](https://www.nexusmods.com/starwarsempireatwar/mods/1859)
config.lsp.debug.logLevel.markdownDescri:
How much the LSP server logs. The lines appear in the output channel *Alamo Engine Tools - Empire at War Edit*; a Debug build of the server also writes them to a log file in the first workspace folder. `Debug` adds the lines that say whether a document reached a sync handler, which is what a session publishing no diagnostics has to be diagnosed from.

Wire traffic is `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.debug.traceServer#`. Takes effect on the next server start.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.debug.traceServer.markdownDes:
LSP wire-protocol trace level. Set to `messages` or `verbose` to log traffic in the output panel for debugging.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.debug.waitForDebugger.markdow:
Pass `--wait-for-debugger` to the LSP server process on startup, causing it to pause until a .NET debugger attaches.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.devMode.enabled.markdownDescr:
Start the LSP server from source using `dotnet run --project` instead of a pre-built executable. Requires `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.devMode.projectPath#` to be set.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.devMode.projectPath.markdownD: Path to the `PG.StarWarsGame.LSP.Server.csproj` file used when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.devMode#` is enabled.
config.lsp.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables the Empire at War specific LSP server.
config.lsp.executable.markdownDescriptio:
Path to a `PG.StarWarsGame.LSP.Server.exe` (or `.dll`) to run instead of the server bundled with the extension. Leave empty for the bundled server.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true` and `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.devMode.enabled#` is `false`.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.lsp.locale.markdownDescription:
Language locale used for hover text and diagnostics.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.localisation.language.markdow:
Which of the game's languages to resolve when showing translated text for a localisation key.

This is the *game's* language. It is separate from `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.locale#`, which sets the language this extension writes its own hover text and diagnostics in.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.schema.localPath.markdownDesc:
Path to the schema repository's `eaw` folder, the one holding `_index.json` (`schema/eaw/`, not the repository root). The Lua stubs are read from the `lua` folder beside it.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.schema.source#` is `local`.
config.lsp.schema.source.markdownDescrip:
Where to load the EaW XML schema from. Use `http` to fetch from GitHub (default); use `local` to point at a local copy.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.schema.url.markdownDescriptio:
Custom HTTP URL for the EaW XML schema index. Leave empty to use the newest compatible schema release.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.schema.source#` is `http`.
config.lsp.source.baseGameDirectory.mark:
Install directory of **Star Wars: Empire at War**.

Assets that ship with the game - models, textures, the string table - are only reachable once this is set. The extension never searches for an install.
config.lsp.source.baseline.localPath.mar:
Path to a local baseline `.aet` file.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.source.baseline.type#` is `local`.
config.lsp.source.baseline.type.markdown:
Where to load the EaW baseline index from. Use `http` to download automatically, or `local` to point at a file.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.enabled#` is set to `true`.
config.lsp.source.baseline.url.markdownD:
Custom HTTP URL for the baseline `.aet` file. Leave empty to read the newest baseline release this server supports.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.source.baseline.type#` is `http`.
config.lsp.source.expansionDirectory.mar:
Install directory of **Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption**.

Searched alongside `#aet-eaw-edit.lsp.source.baseGameDirectory#` for assets that ship with the game.
config.lua.analyzerPath.markdownDescript:
Path to an `emmylua_ls` executable to run instead of the Lua analyzer bundled with the extension. Leave empty for the bundled analyzer.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.features.lua.analyzer#` is on.

Changing this setting automatically restarts the LSP server.
config.modVerify.executable.markdownDesc:
The path to the [ModVerify](https://github.com/AlamoEngine-Tools/ModVerify/releases) executable.

Only applies when `#aet-eaw-edit.modVerify.enabled#` is set to `true`.

config.shaders.directory.markdownDescrip:
Folder holding the base game's shader **sources** (`.fx`), used to preview models closer to how the game draws them.

These are published by Petroglyph for mod tooling and are **never redistributed with this extension** - point this at a locally extracted copy. Run *EaWEdit: Set Up Base Shader Sources* for help.

A game install does not contain them: It ships compiled `.fxo` bytecode instead.
config.shaders.sourceUrl.markdownDescrip:
Download location for *Set Up Base Shader Sources*. For proxies, mirrors and air-gapped machines.

Leave empty to use Petroglyph's published download.
config.storySimulator.assumeMediaComplet:
Story simulation: A speech or movie a reward starts is taken to complete on the next tick, so the `STORY_SPEECH_DONE` and `STORY_MOVIE_DONE` listeners that wait on it fire on their own. Off, each such listener is a decision for the author until it is answered or the engine's 60 s timeout ends it - for stepping through media by hand.

A listener no reward starts is a decision either way; that is a structural problem in the story, not a media length.

Takes effect when a simulation starts.
config.storySimulator.autoResume.markdow: Story simulation: When play paused itself because the clock had nothing left but a decision, answering the decision resumes play. Off, play stays paused until pressed again.
config.tools.aloViewerExecutable.markdow:
Full path to `AloViewer.exe`.

The in-editor preview is read-only; this is the tool the *Open in AloViewer* button hands the current model to. Left empty, the button reports that nothing is configured - the extension never searches for an install.
config.tools.particleEditorExecutable.ma:
Full path to `ParticleEditor.exe`.

The preview is read-only; this is the tool the *Open in Particle Editor* button hands the current subject to. Left empty, the button reports that nothing is configured - the extension never searches for an install.
